title: Design System: Aeterna Cemetery Management System

title.purpose: Card titles and table column headers

components.name: Primary Municipal Button
components.description: Primary action button for new records and confirmations
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #00236f; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 13px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0051d5; }

components.name: Status Pill Disponible
components.css: .ds-chip-disponible { background: #e8f5e9; color: #1b5e20; border: 1px solid #c8e6c9; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

narrative.overview: Aeterna Parque is an institutional management and cadastral system engineered for municipal cemeteries and funeral services in Chamical, La Rioja.
keyCharacteristics: Institutional Authority grounded in municipal deep navy (#00236f)

rules.name: The Municipal Solemnity Rule
rules.body: Primary navy #00236f anchors hierarchy, saturated tones strictly reserved for status.

rules.name: The Tabular Alignment Rule
rules.body: All currencies, dates, and parcel numbers must use monospaced tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Structural Border Rule
rules.body: Depth is established via 1px outline-variant borders on surface containers rather than blurry shadows.

dos: Format plot nomenclatures as SECTOR-MANZANA-PARCELA in font-mono
Highlight COVID-19 records with violet badges
Use bg-surface-container-lowest for cards and bg-surface for canvas
donts: Do not use generic raw RGB colors when semantic tokens exist
Do not use border-radius larger than 12px
